==The Grey Comedy==
[[File:2412.png|thumb|400px]]Connects to: 02.22, 15.13, 17.14 and 23.11.

Tonight, the [[Grey Comedy]] performs on the commons outside [[Winds]]. This will be the first time that the Comedy performs by the [[White Road]] ([[29.13]]). Word has it that an elf noble intends to sneak in and watch the show.
